_note: SecLLM model catalog. Default set is US-origin open-weight models (SecRouter supply-chain posture). Copy to models.json, edit, and point SECLLM_CATALOG at it. Add any model you like — PRC-jurisdiction models are simply excluded from the shipped defaults. This file mirrors the built-in catalog (src/secllm/catalog.py) plus one extra example entry (Llama-3.1-8B).

models.name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
models.description: Small Meta model; low latency for simple tasks.

models.name: Gemma 4 26B (A4B MoE)
models.description: Google's mixture-of-experts (4B active of 26B total); high-throughput reasoning at a fraction of the dense per-token cost. (The 12B is a unified multimodal checkpoint that doesn't serve as text, so this is the 26B.)

models.name: gpt-oss-20b
models.description: OpenAI open-weight reasoning model; efficient. Same family SecRouter defaults to on Bedrock.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct
models.description: High quality; needs a large or multi-GPU host.

models.name: Gemma 4 — 31B
models.description: Google's flagship dense model; 256K context, strong reasoning/coding — bridges server-grade quality and local execution.

models.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
models.description: General-purpose 8B; solid quality at moderate GPU cost. (Example of a catalog addition beyond the built-in set.)
